jobs.title: Student Worker in Sustainable Operations
jobs.description_md:
**Job Description**

We’re looking for a proactive and curious Student Worker to join our Sustainable Operations team. You will be supporting driving LEGO Group's energy decarbonization agenda through data analytics, reporting, project coordination, and stakeholder communication. The role offers hands-on experience in sustainability strategy implementation, energy management, carbon reporting, and renewable energy initiatives while supporting key business decisions and climate commitment.

  

## Core responsibilities

  

* Support energy data analysis, forecasting, and consumption modelling to inform sustainability and operational decision-making.
* Perform calculations and business case assessments for energy efficiency and decarbonization projects, supporting investment approvals and savings reporting.
* Provide administrative support for project tracking, team activities, and follow-up actions.

* Develop data visualizations, dashboards, and management reporting in Excel and PowerPoint to support decision-making and strategic oversight.
* Create presentations, one-pagers, and storytelling materials to communicate sustainability initiatives and drive stakeholder engagement across functions.
* Document processes, governance structures, and methodologies for the climate and carbonworkstreams

  

## Play a part in our team succeeding

  

Sustainable Operations is the global department within LEGO Group that leads the change journey towards zero environmental impact in our factories. We lead, design and implement sustainable solutions primarily within energy/CO2, water, and waste - in a circular mindset. Moreover, we are responsible for managing the tracking of realized reductions towards zero-impact, and the programme office for sustainability in Engineering & Workplace. We identify and implement reduction projects in close collaboration with the production sites and other partners

jobs.title: Vil du være med til at lave økonomiske analyser, der flytter samfundet? Bliv student i DI
jobs.location: DI København - Industriens Hus H. C. Andersens Blvd. 18 1553 København Denmark DI København - Industriens Hus H. C. Andersens Blvd. 18 1553 København Denmark København
jobs.description_md:
**Om os**

I DI’s enhed for økonomisk politik og analyse følger vi på tætteste hold udviklingen i dansk og international økonomi og den økonomiske politik. Vores ambition er at være Danmarks førende videnscenter om virksomhederne og deres økonomiske situation. Tre gange om året udarbejder vi en prognose for dansk økonomi, og fire gange om året tager vi temperaturen på dansk erhvervsliv gennem en rundspørge til vores medlemmer i DI’s Virksomhedspanel.

Vi supplerer konjunkturovervågningen med analyser af blandt andet eksport, produktivitet, erhvervsstrukturer, offentlige finanser og investeringer. Alle analyser offentliggøres, indgår i den offentlige debat og understøtter DI’s politiske arbejde. Vi leverer også data, beregninger og analyser til resten af DI. F.eks. har vi udarbejdet en 2035-plan, der danner grundlag for DI’s politiske interessevaretagelse. Og vi står bag det analytiske fundament i DI’s undersøgelse af erhvervsvilkårene i kommunerne, Lokal Erhvervsvenlighed.

**Om jobbet**

Du bliver en del af en studentergruppe på fire studenter. Herudover består enheden af syv økonomer, en data scientist og en chef. Arbejdet giver dig rig mulighed for at få en praktisk vinkel på teorierne fra studiet. Du vil indgå i de faglige diskussioner med afdelingens økonomer og opnå en dybere forståelse af dansk og international økonomi samt aktuelle økonomisk-politiske problemstillinger.

Vi giver dig grundig oplæring og løbende faglig sparring. I takt med at du bliver fortrolig med opgaverne, får du ansvar for egne leverancer og mulighed for at skrive analyser, bidrage til præsentationer og holde oplæg i og uden for DI. Du vil også få en række løbende ad hoc-opgaver, der spænder fra overvågning af økonomiske nøgletal og arbejde med data, beregninger og bidrag til analyser. Vores vigtigste arbejdsredskaber er Excel, SAS, R og Python.

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt omkring 15 timer om ugen. Vi tilrettelægger arbejdet fleksibelt og tager hensyn til undervisning og eksamener, herunder med mulighed for læsefri.

Vi sidder i et åbent kontormiljø i vores lokaler på Rådhuspladsen og har en uformel omgangstone, hvor dialog, udvikling og samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Du bliver også en del af fællesskabet blandt studenter på tværs af DI’s politiske område og af det tværgående studenternetværk CAMP, som løbende arrangerer sociale aktiviteter.

**Om dig**

Du studerer økonomi og har et højt fagligt niveau, stærke analytiske evner og interesse for samfundsøkonomiske problemstillinger. Måske har du allerede kendskab til analyse eller programmering i f.eks. SAS, Python eller R fra studiet eller et andet job – ellers vil du gerne lære det.Du har lyst til at bruge din teoretiske viden til at arbejde med praktiske økonomiske analyser i en politisk organisation som DI.

**Interesseret?**

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, kan du kontakte chefkonsulent Asger Bjerg Pedersen på tlf. 5218 5921.

Send dit CV og karakterudskrift via ansøgningslinket senest d. 11. oktober 2026. I stedet for at sende en traditionel ansøgning, vil vi bede dig svare på tre spørgsmål om din motivation og interesse for stillingen i ansøgningssystemet. Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 42 og 43.

jobs.title: Student Assistant, Netcompany Institute
jobs.description_md:
*How does Europe reap the benefits of AI, while remaining secure, sovereign and true to its democratic values? These are some of the questions that Netcompany Institute has set out to answer, and we are looking for two student assistants to help us do just that.*

*Netcompany Institute is a new analytical unit providing data-driven analyses of how AI and digitalization affect Europe. The aim is to strengthen the evidence base for public debate and help decision-makers navigate the choices that will shape Europe’s digital future.  You'll join a small team: a Chief Economist and two full-time Analytics Consultants.*

**Responsibilities**

You will support analyses throughout their lifecycle – from framing questions to communicating results. Your responsibilites will typically include:

* Monitor policy developments and research on AI and digitalisation in Europe
* Collect and structure data from Eurostat, OECD and statistical offices
* Produce descriptive statistics, tables and charts publication-ready
* Write analytical text and fact-check sources

Responsibility grows with experience. At the beginning you will work closely with an Analytics Consultant on clearly defined tasks; over time we expect you to take ownership of analyses in your own right.

**How we work with AI**

AI tools are integral to our work. We use them for literature searches, data work and monitoring – so human time focuses on what matters most: finding the right questions, interpreting results and communicating them clearly. You don't need expertise at the start, but must be willing to learn and maintain high accuracy standards.

**About you**

We are looking for two students who can each work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to publication deadlines and events. To succeed in this role, you:

* Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in economics, political science, statistics, data science or a similar field.
* Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a must; Danish is an advantage.
* Are comfortable working with data: confident in Excel and ideally familiar with Python, R, Stata or a similar tool.
* Are curious about how AI and digitalisation are changing European economies and societies
* Are willing to learn to use AI tools effectively in your own work, and to keep relating output critically to prior knowledge and theory.

jobs.title: Studentermedhjælper til Customer Service & Logistics
jobs.description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Vil du være en vigtig del af den daglige drift i en global virksomhed og samtidig opbygge værdifuld erfaring inden for administration, logistik og kundeservice? I Customer Service & Logistics bliver du en del af en afdeling med omkring 40 kolleger, som hver dag sikrer, at kunder over hele verden modtager deres produkter korrekt og til tiden.

  

Som studentermedhjælper kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med to andre studentermedhjælpere og kolleger på tværs af afdelingen. Sammen understøtter i de administrative processer, der er afgørende for pålidelige leverancer og en stærk kundeoplevelse.

  

**Rollen & dit bidrag**Som studentermedhjælper får du en vigtig operativ rolle, hvor du understøtter Customer Service & Logistics med administrative opgaver, dokumenthåndtering og koordinering. Du bliver en del af et team med højt fokus på kvalitet, service og samarbejde.

  

**Dine primære ansvarsområder i denne rolle**

  

* Udarbejde eksportdokumenter samt opdatere og vedligeholde forskellige dokumenter.
* Håndtere og besvare generelle spørgsmål og opgaver fra interne interessenter via en fælles mailboks.
* Indkøbe mindre kontorudstyr via en online platform.
* Understøtte kolleger i Customer Service and Logistics med forskellige administrative ad hoc-opgaver.

  

**Hvad der skal til for, at du får succes i denne rolle**

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  

* Er i gang med første eller andet år af en bacheloruddannelse, gerne inden for logistik, Supply Chain Management eller en anden relevant uddannelse.
* Taler og skriver flydende dansk.
* Har gode engelskkundskaber, både skriftligt og mundtligt.
* Har erfaring med Microsoft Office-pakken, herunder Excel, Word og PowerPoint.
* Har evnen til hurtigt at sætte dig ind i nye administrative systemer og arbejdsprocesser.
* Er struktureret, detaljeorienteret, og kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver.
* Er god til at kommunikere og samarbejde med forskellige interessenter.
* Er resultatorienteret og kan håndtere flere opgaver og deadlines samtidigt.

  

**Andre færdigheder og interesser, som vi værdsætter**

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du:

  

* Har interesse for logistik, supply chain eller international handel.
* Har erfaring med Adobe-programmer.
* Har tidligere erfaring fra et administrativt studiejob.
* Trives med at identificere forbedringsmuligheder og tage initiativ til nye løsninger.

**Det, vi kan tilbyde dig**Du får mulighed for at opbygge relevant erhvervserfaring ved siden af studiet og opnå værdifuld indsigt i kundeservice, logistik og supply chain-processer. Samtidig bliver du en del af et engageret og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø, hvor ansvar, tillid og faglig udvikling er centrale værdier, og hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med kolleger på tværs af organisationen.

Arbejdsstedet er i Bagsværd, hvor fysisk fremmøde på kontoret er en forudsætning, da hjemmearbejde ikke er muligt i rollen. Der forventes gensidig fleksibilitet i forhold til arbejdsbelastning, eksamensperioder og deadlines. Arbejdet består af kontorbaserede administrative opgaver uden væsentlige fysiske krav og foregår i et professionelt arbejdsmiljø i Customer Service & Logistics.

# Metodestærke studerende med interesse for forskning i familieforhold og demografi søges

stillingsopslag

September 2026

Link er kopieret

### **Metodestærke studerende med interesse for forskning i familieforhold og demografi søges**

Er du glad for tal og data? Vil du være med til at styrke forskningen i, hvordan sociale forhold påvirker hvem der får børn, og hvilke opvækstvilkår de børn får? Og vil du arbejde i et etableret forskningsmiljø som ROCKWOOL Fonden? Så er nedenstående stilling som studentermedarbejder måske noget for dig.

Vi søger en selvstændig, dygtig og engageret studerende (økonomi, sociologi, folkesundhedsvidenskab, statskundskab, e.l.) med mindst 1½ år tilbage på studiet, der kan arbejde ca. 15 timer om ugen. Arbejdstiden tilpasses dit skema, og der er stor fleksibilitet i forbindelse med opgaver og eksamener.  Ud over solide teoretiske kundskaber og faglige ambitioner vil følgende være en fordel:

* Erfaring med brug af statistiske software-pakker (Stata, R, Python, e.l.)
* Erfaring med registerdata
* Interesse for og kendskab til den offentlige debat om samfundsøkonomi og demografi
* Interesse for formidling og gode skriftlige evner og samarbejdsevner

Arbejdet vil dels bestå i udarbejdelse af en række selvstændige opgaver, dels i at bistå forskere, som er tilknyttet forskningsenheden, i deres videnskabelige arbejde. Undervejs vil der være rig mulighed for at stifte bekendtskab med samspillet mellem teori og empirisk baseret forskning.

ROCKWOOL Fonden har til formål at producere ny, empirisk viden om aktuelle samfundsproblemer på et uafhængigt grundlag. Forskningsenheden består af ca. 60 medarbejdere.

Vi tilbyder et levende forskningsmiljø og en behagelig arbejdsplads beliggende i det centrale København.

Er du interesseret i stillingen, beder vi dig sende en ansøgning vedlagt karakterudskrift og CV via dette [link](https://candidate.hr-manager.net/ApplicationInit.aspx?cid=2797&ProjectId=143621&DepartmentId=18956&SkipAdvertisement=true) senest den 1**1. oktober 2026.**

Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til forskningsprofessor Peter Fallesen ([pf@rff.dk](mailto:pf@rff.dk), 61333184) og på hjemmesiden **www.rockwoolfonden.dk**

# Studentermedhjælper til Copilot og RPA

LB Forsikring

København Ø

*Er du interesseret i muligheden for at kombinere teknologi, struktur og samarbejde? Vi søger to nysgerrige og strukturerede studentermedhjælpere, der kan hjælpe os med governance, dokumentation, kommunikation og lettere udviklingsopgaver i vores Copilot- og RPA-team.*

*Vil du gerne forandre og være noget særligt for andre? Som medarbejder i LB får du mere substans i dit job, hvor vilkår, goder og fleksibilitet gavner det hele menneske. Hos LB Forsikring lægger vi sjæl i arbejdet, og vi møder medlemmer, kolleger og omverden med skærpet sans. Du bliver en del af et medlemsejet fællesskab, hvor vi er der for hinanden. Vi deler også målet om at gøre forsikring overflødig.*

## Lyder de her opgaver som noget for dig?

Som studentermedhjælper bliver du en del af Copilot- og RPA-teamet i Digitale Produkter. Vi arbejder med at skabe tydelige rammer for ansvarlig anvendelse og omsætte relevante behov til enkle, brugbare løsninger.

## Dine fem væsentligste opgaver vil være:

* Understøtte governance for Copilot og RPA, fx ved at vedligeholde retningslinjer, skabeloner, beslutningslog og øvrig dokumentation.
* Hjælpe med at skabe overblik over use cases, idéer, risici, afhængigheder og status i teamets backlog.
* Bidrage til lettere udvikling, konfiguration og test af Copilot-agenter og automatiseringsflows under vejledning fra teamets specialister.
* Dokumentere løsninger, testresultater og arbejdsprocesser.
* Bidrage til forberedelse af workshops, kommunikation, brugerfeedback og enkel opfølgning på anvendelse og effekt.

## Vil du være en del af vores fællesskab?

Vi ønsker, at du trives, og at vi når vores mål sammen. Derfor kigger vi blandt andet på, om du har følgende faglige og personlige færdigheder til jobbet:

* Du er i gang med en relevant videregående uddannelse, fx IT, data science, digitalisering, business, informationsvidenskab eller lignende.
* Du arbejder struktureret og kan omsætte komplekse emner til korte, præcise beskrivelser og oversigter.
* Du har teknisk interesse og lyst til at lære Microsoft Copilot og RPA (UIPath). Erfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
* Du er ansvarlig, kvalitetsbevidst og opmærksom på datasikkerhed, governance og dokumentation.
* Du kommunikerer godt på dansk og engelsk og samarbejder godt med både tekniske og forretningsmæssige kolleger.

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele på forhånd, men vi forventer, at du er nysgerrig, grundig og har lyst til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem teknologi, governance og forretning.

Vi leder efter to forskellige profiler, der kan supplere hinanden i teamet. Måske er du den tekniske profil, der motiveres af Copilot, RPA, udvikling og test, eller måske er du den kommunikative profil, der er stærk til at skabe struktur, formidle og gøre komplekse emner forståelige. Kan du se dig selv i begge profiler, er det selvfølgelig kun en fordel. Fortæl os i din ansøgning, hvilken profil du primært ser dig selv som.

## Vi har spurgt tre kommende kolleger om, hvordan de oplever LB

> *Jeg vil gerne byde ind med noget banebrydende.*

> *Jeg vil gerne være den, som altid er til hjælp.*

> *Jeg vil gerne få alle til at føle sig som en del af fællesskabet.*

Hvis du synes, jobbet lyder spændende og ønsker mere information, er du velkommen til at kontakte IT-udviklingschef Eva Beim på [EVBE@lb.dk](mailto:EVBE@lb.dk).

jobs.title: IT Service Desk Teamlead, Novonesis
jobs.description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Are you an experienced people leader who is passionate about building high-performing IT support teams and delivering seamless digital experiences? At Novonesis, we are looking for a Team Lead to lead our Denmark-based ITSM ServiceDesk team and take full leadership responsibility for the people, performance, and day-to-day operation of Local IT support. 

In this role, you will be the leader of the Danish ServiceDesk team — setting direction and goals, developing your team, and owning the results your team delivers to employees across the organization. Working in a global ITSM environment, you will combine people leadership, operational management, and service excellence to ensure that the Service Desk consistently meets its targets and continuously raises the standard of IT support across Novonesis. 

 

**The Role & Your Impact** 

As Team Lead for the ITSM ServiceDesk in Denmark, you will lead a team of 12 ServiceDesk supporters plus a group of student assistants. You hold full personnel responsibility for the team and are accountable for both the wellbeing and the performance of your team. You set the goals, you build the team, and you own the outcomes. 

You are responsible for the full people-leadership cycle — from recruiting the right talent and onboarding new colleagues to coaching, developing, and following up on performance, so that every team member knows what is expected and has what they need to succeed. 

Beyond leading people, you own the operational delivery of the team: staffing and shift coverage, workload prioritization, escalation handling, and adherence to agreed service levels. You translate the Global ITSM strategy into clear team goals, track performance through ServiceNow analytics, and act on the data to keep improving. 

  

Your key leadership responsibilities include: 

* Lead, motivate, and develop a team of 12 ServiceDesk supporters and student assistants through regular one-to-ones, feedback, and structured development conversations.

* Set clear team and individual goals aligned to Global ITSM targets, and manage performance against defined KPIs such as SLA compliance, First Contact Resolution, CSAT, and escalation quality.

* Own workforce planning, recruitment, and onboarding to ensure the right capabilities and coverage on the team.

* Recognize and grow strong performers, and follow up constructively when performance or collaboration needs to improve.

* Manage rotations, shift coverage, and daily prioritization so the Service Desk consistently meets its service levels throughout the working day.

* Act as the escalation point for complex or sensitive cases, and safeguard the quality and consistency of the support your team delivers.

* Represent the Danish ServiceDesk toward Global IT, resolver groups, and business stakeholders, and coordinate closely with peer team leads across the global hubs.

* Use ServiceNow reporting to monitor trends, remove recurring issues, and drive service improvement within the team.

* Enable team members to take part in projects and in improving ways of working, balancing this with daily operational demands.

 

**What You'll Need to Be Successful** 

To succeed in this role, you bring proven people-leadership experience combined with a solid background in IT support and service management. 

We imagine that you have a degree, certification, or equivalent background within Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, combined with experience from IT support, ServiceDesk operations, or similar customer-facing IT functions. As a minimum, we require 5 years of experience managing a team of at least 8 people. 

Just as important as your experience is how you lead. You have strong people skills and a high level of emotional intelligence: you build trust, read people and situations well, and adapt your leadership to the individual. You set clear expectations, handle difficult conversations with respect, and use service management data to steer your team and its results. 

 

In addition, you possess: 

* Strong people skills and a high level of emotional intelligence.

* Experience with recruitment, onboarding, coaching, and developing team members.

* Strong goal-setting and performance-management skills, with the ability to turn KPIs and analytics into action.

* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, and the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical audiences.

* A calm, fair, and solution-oriented leadership style, especially in high-pressure situations.

* Fluent Danish and English, both written and spoken.

* A strong sense of ownership and accountability for your team's performance and results.

 

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value** 

Experience leading teams in global organizations and complex enterprise environments would be an advantage, as would knowledge of ITIL principles and best practices and hands-on experience with ServiceNow. We also value experience with workforce planning, shift-based operations, and participation in service improvement, digital workplace, or IT transformation programs. 

Additional language skills and experience collaborating across cultures and time zones are also considered valuable. 

 

**What We Offer** 

At Novonesis, you will become part of a global IT organization that plays a critical role in enabling business performance and innovation. As Team Lead, you will have real ownership of your team and its results, with the mandate to shape how Local IT support is delivered in Denmark and the opportunity to influence the wider global ServiceDesk. 

We offer a collaborative and international work environment, leadership development opportunities, exposure to global IT initiatives, and the chance to build and grow a team that makes a difference for employees worldwide. You will join an organization that values people leadership, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and a strong commitment to service excellence. 

 

**Ways of Working / Working Conditions** 

You will lead a Denmark-based team while working in a highly collaborative international environment, with close interaction across Global IT functions, peer team leads, and business stakeholders worldwide. The role combines hands-on team leadership with daily operational management and requires regular engagement with users and stakeholders across regions and organizational levels. As a people leader, you are responsible for the performance, development, and wellbeing of your team, and success requires a high degree of professionalism, fairness, and the ability to build trust with both your team and stakeholders across the organization. 

 

**Relevant Information**

**Contact Information:** IT service Manager Thomas Fellov Møller - thmo@novonesis.com

**Location**: Hørsholm/Lyngby 

 

**Vores formål viser vejen**

I Novonesis ved vi, at løsninger forankret i biologi kan hjælpe med at løse verdens største udfordringer. Siden vi begyndte for mere end et århundrede siden, har dette været vores pejlemærke. Det er sådan, vi er nået så langt. Og det er sådan, vi vil påvirke fremtiden. Nu, mere end nogensinde, har verden brug for forandring. Og med biosolutions er mulighederne for transformation uendelige. Hvis vores formål giver mening for dig, opfordrer vi dig til at søge.

Arbejdstiden bliver i gennemsnit 15 timer om ugen og fastlægges, så der tages hensyn til undervisning og eksaminer. Du får derfor fleksibilitet og mulighed for at lære af dygtige og erfarne kolleger undervejs. Til gengæld forventer vi af dig, at du viser engagement og tager ansvar.  
 **Om dig**  
Du brænder for at skabe indhold på digitale platforme og kan lide at møde nye mennesker.  
Du arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og tager ansvar, samtidig med at du gerne bringer dine gode idéer i spil. Sprogligt er du stærk i både dansk og engelsk, så du kan skrive korte, præcise tekster og finde fængende overskrifter til artiklerne.

jobs.title: Student Assistant for the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation Project
jobs.description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Would you like to help drive one of the most significant packaging regulations in Europe while gaining hands-on experience in global program and project management?

  

Join the PPWR Team in Novonesis' Supply Chain organization and become part of a newly established team responsible for driving our global PPWR Program and supporting compliance with the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation. This is a unique opportunity to join a team at the beginning of an important journey, helping Novonesis prepare for a more sustainable packaging future.

  

Today, we are five colleagues representing four nationalities, and we are growing as the program moves into execution. We combine a structured PMO setup and strong project management framework with an open, curious, and pragmatic way of working, creating an environment where learning and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do.

  

**The role & your impact**As a Student Assistant in the PPWR Team, you will provide dedicated support to the PMO Manager and contribute to creating structure, transparency, and progress across a global transformation program.

You will gain valuable insight into how large-scale programs are managed while supporting projects that span multiple functions, stakeholders, and geographies across Novonesis.

  

**In this role, you will make an impact by:**

  

* Collecting, consolidating, and following up on project status updates, milestones, risks, actions, and decisions across the program.
* Supporting financial tracking and reporting by gathering inputs, validating data quality, and preparing clear overviews for decision-making.
* Preparing steering committee presentations, agendas, meeting materials, and other decision-support documentation.
* Supporting program communication and helping ensure information is accurate, current, and accessible to stakeholders.
* Providing day-to-day PMO support, including meeting documentation, action follow-up, coordination of inputs, and stakeholder communication.

  

**What you will need to be successful**We imagine that you are currently enrolled in a relevant higher-education program and are looking to gain practical experience within program management, business operations, finance, or supply chain.

  

**To succeed in this role, you bring:**

  

* Enrollment in a relevant degree program such as business administration, economics, finance, supply chain management, project management, communication, or a related field.
* Strong analytical skills and an interest in understanding how projects, finances, compliance requirements, and business priorities connect.
* Experience working with data and the ability to organize information, identify inconsistencies, and create structured overviews.
* Good skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and professional written and spoken English.

  

**We are looking for someone who:**

  

* Is structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* Is proactive and able to work independently while knowing when to seek guidance and reliable and committed to delivering high-quality work with accuracy and attention to detail.

  

**While not required, it would be an advantage if you have:**

  

* Experience with Teams, SharePoint, or similar collaboration and documentation tools.
* An interest in project management, PMO processes, compliance, or supply chain operations.
* Experience supporting administrative, coordination, or back-office activities.
* An interest in working across functions and engaging with stakeholders from different parts of the organization.
* Curiosity about sustainability, packaging regulation, and business transformation initiatives.

  

**What we offer**You will become part of a purpose-driven company where biology powers solutions to some of the world's biggest challenges.

  

**In this role, you can expect:**

  

* A unique opportunity to join a newly established global program team and contribute to an important strategic initiative.
* Hands-on experience with PMO disciplines, program governance, project reporting, stakeholder management, and business communication.
* Close collaboration with experienced project and program professionals.
* Exposure to senior stakeholders and cross-functional collaboration across Novonesis.
* A supportive, international, and collaborative team environment with strong opportunities for learning and development.

  

**Ways of working**You will be based in Lyngby and working closely with the PPWR Team. Working arrangements can be agreed together with the hiring manager based on business needs and study commitments.

  

**Application deadline:** October 4th, 2026.We will screen in-coming applications and invite for interviews continuously during the application period, so please apply as soon as possible.

**Contact information :** Jens Herping Ellegaard, Head of Global PPWR Strategy & Compliance at  [**JNHE@novonesis.com**](mailto:JNHE@novonesis.com)**.**

**Vores formål viser vejen**

I Novonesis ved vi, at løsninger forankret i biologi kan hjælpe med at løse verdens største udfordringer. Siden vi begyndte for mere end et århundrede siden, har dette været vores pejlemærke. Det er sådan, vi er nået så langt. Og det er sådan, vi vil påvirke fremtiden. Nu, mere end nogensinde, har verden brug for forandring. Og med biosolutions er mulighederne for transformation uendelige. Hvis vores formål giver mening for dig, opfordrer vi dig til at søge.

Har du flair for data og gode kommunikationsevner, og vil du være med til at researche, udarbejde og formidle analyser inden for uddannelsespolitik? Du bliver en del af DI’s enhed for Erhvervs- og arbejdsmarkedsuddannelser, hvor vi beskæftiger os med uddannelsespolitik knyttet til erhvervsuddannelser, de gymnasiale uddannelser og arbejdsmarkedsuddannelser m.fl. Vi søger en student, der kan bistå os med opgaver i samarbejde med vores to andre studenter og enhedens konsulenter. Her er eksempler på nogle af dine arbejdsopgaver:

· Datatræk via offentlige registre og forskeradgang

· Skrive analyse og hjælpe med præsentationer

· Overvågning af udviklingen på uddannelsesområdet

· Hjælpe med forberedelse af møder og oplæg

· Derudover kan du også blive koblet til længerevarende projekter, der er med til at understøtte DI’s langsigtede indsatser på uddannelsesområdet

**Om dig**

· Du er detaljeorienteret og fanger fejl

· Du er analytisk, struktureret og tryg ved Excel samt har kendskab til statistiksoftware

· Du har en interesse for at arbejde med politiske dagsordner

· Du trives med at veksle mellem faglige og praktiske opgaver

· Du har flair for formidling

jobs.title: Digital Technology Student Worker - Data Science
jobs.description_md:
**Job Description**

Just imagine helping decide which LEGO® sets appear on shelves for different customers around the world. Then make it real.

**About the role**

As our Data Science Student Worker, you'll support the team behind the next version of our stock keeping unit (SKU) performance scoring system, run experiments to improve novelty predictions, and help evolve assortment optimization tools. You'll work alongside experienced data scientists on real production pipelines, contributing to data preparation, experimentation, analysis, and production code. It's a hands-on role designed to help you learn while making a meaningful contribution from week one.

**Required Qualifications**

* Solid Python fundamentals

* Good understanding of data analysis and machine learning concepts, e.g. from coursework or other experience

* Comfortable with SQL and working with tabular data

* Fluent English

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to optimization / operations research (e.g. linear programming)

* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Databricks, AWS)

* Experience with pyspark

**What you'll build**

* Support the development of the next generation of SKU performance scoring capabilities

* Run experiments that improve prediction models and generate actionable insights

* Contribute to assortment optimisation tools used by hundreds of users every day

* Help maintain and improve production data science solutions

* Work with experienced team members to turn analysis into practical outcomes

If you've worked in a role where you used real data to answer business questions, you'll feel at home here. What matters most is your ability to learn, contribute to shared code, and translate analysis into meaningful improvements.

**Life on the team**

You'll join the Assortment & Space Management team within Digital Technology. We help deliver customer- and channel-specific assortment recommendations while creating greater portfolio transparency across the business. Our team works in a hybrid rhythm with daily stand-ups and weekly team sessions, including anchor days on Tuesdays and Thursdays. You'll work closely with data scientists and software engineers while bringing curiosity, reliability, and a strong team spirit to everything you do.

**What success looks like**

Success means confidently contributing to production systems, running experiments that improve model performance, and becoming a trusted member of the team. Over the next 12 to 18 months, we're focused on rolling out a new version of our core product performance scoring and prediction system. You'll work closely with data scientists and software engineers to help shape that journey while building skills that can grow with you at the LEGO Group.

**We're looking for students who**

* Are currently enrolled in Denmark in a **Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Erhvervsakademi** (professional academy) program in fields related to data.

* Preferably graduating summer 2028 or beyond, having at least 1.5-2 years left of studies

* Are curious and willing to learn, with a **positive, team-player attitude**.

* Can be present 15–20 hours per week, ideally with 1–2 days at our **LEGO Campus in Billund**.

* Are passionate about digital technology and eager to contribute to real projects.

If you're interested in joining us, please prepare your CV and cover letter in English.

The application portal will remain open from 14th September to 12th October 2026, but it may be taken down earlier so we urge you to apply as soon as possible. If you are shortlisted, you will be invited to attend our Assessment Day on 4th November 2026 at our Kornmarken Campus in Billund. Following the Assessment Day, there will be one final interview round. The expected start date for successful candidates is either 1st December 2026 or 1st January 2027.

#LI-MF2

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**What’s in it for you?**

Here is what you can expect:

**Family Care Leave** - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

**Insurances** – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

**Wellbeing** - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

**Colleague Discount** – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

**Bonus** - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

**Workplace** - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

**Join the LEGO® team today.**

jobs.title: Join Halfspace’s Strategy & Execution Team: Associate Engagement Manager (Part-Time, Student Position)
jobs.description_md:
At Halfspace, part of Faculty, we help organisations use artificial intelligence to make better, more informed decisions, faster. We began by predicting outcomes in live football matches and have since delivered more than one hundred AI and data projects across industries, earning international recognition for our work.

What truly defines us is our people. Builders and practitioners who learn fast, challenge each other kindly, and bring genuine curiosity about hard problems. Our team brings together expertise across physics, engineering, mathematics, statistics, operations research, computer science, chemistry, economics, biology, design, and strategy. Halfspace is focused on deep expertise in applied AI. We describe our approach as "inch wide, mile deep".

As an Associate Engagement Manager (part-time) in our Strategy and Execution team, you will sit close to live consulting work and learn how AI strategy actually gets done. This is a student position, designed to fit alongside a bachelor’s or master’s degree, and the role is built around supporting project teams on real client engagements: research, structured analysis, slide work, and the kind of synthesis that helps senior consultants make sharper recommendations. You are here to learn the craft alongside people who do it every day.

Day to day, the work shifts as projects move. One week, it might be a piece of desk research on how a sector is adopting AI. The next, building a deck for client discussion on building a MVPs within their infrastructure. Joining client workshops to see how AI conversations land at the executive level is part of the picture too. Studies come first; the role is designed to flex around exam periods and deadlines.

You will work alongside consultants, engineers, scientists, and strategists, contributing to the same projects but at a scope that fits part-time hours. We value depth, flexibility, trust, and balance. We build a space where curious, thoughtful people can grow while working on projects that matter, alongside some of the world’s most interesting companies.

**Qualifications**

* Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s program in the intersection between tech and business. We are not looking for a specific degree, but example studies could be industrial engineering (cand.polyt), digital business (cand.merc), information system (cand.merc), Design & innovation (cand.polyt), Digital innovation and mgmt. (cand.IT).

* A desire to “translate” between business and tech based on a technical foundation with business flair to solve problems with AI

* Curious about both AI and consulting and drawn to a role where you sit close to real client work across different industries.

* Strong analytical skillset with the ability to structure data, client interviews, SME input, and frameworks into something useful.

* Clear written and verbal communication, across technical and non-technical audiences.

* Comfort with the consulting toolkit (slides, structured documents, basic data work), or the willingness to pick these up quickly.

* Reliable and self-directed incl. managing your own hours, flag when something is unclear, and asking for help when you need it.

* A collaborative default: you lift the people around you and create success within the team instead of focusing on individual performance.

We know that excellent candidates often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement listed. Please apply if you believe you can contribute to this role, even if your background does not match every item above. We would rather see your application than miss you.

**Compensation and Working Arrangements**

This is an Associate Engagement Manager (part-time) position, designed for current students. Expect around 15 to 20 hours per week alongside your studies, with flexibility to scale down during exam periods. We offer a competitive student worker rate, a learning and development budget, and the chance to work on real client engagements from your first week. This is a Copenhagen-based role with preference of people coming to the office. But we want people to bring their whole self, hence we cater for flexibility around your studies and life outside work.

**Life at Halfspace**

We value flexibility, trust, and balance. We invest in learning and development, and we create an environment where people can grow while working on projects that matter. Our clients include some of the world's leading companies, and the work is demanding, but we protect the conditions that make sustained good work possible.

**Location**

Copenhagen.

**About Accenture**

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.

 Visit us at [www.accenture.com](http://www.accenture.com/) 

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by applicable law. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative, more competitive, and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.

jobs.title: Student Assistant - Communication and Marketing in Aarhus
jobs.description_md:
*Vi søger en studentermedhjælper til vores revisionsafdeling i Aarhus, som kan bidrage til vores interne og eksterne kommunikation igennem bl.a. LinkedIn, nyhedsmails og andre spændende projekter.*

**Din rolle**

Som studentermedhjælper bliver du en vigtig del af vores lokale vækst- og markedsføringsindsats i Aarhus. Du kommer til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem kommunikation, marketing og business development såvel internt som eksternt, hvor du bidrager til at øge KPMG's synlighed i markedet og understøtte vores relationer til eksisterende og potentielle kunder.

Du får en bred kontaktflade til partnere, revisorer og vores centrale marketingfunktion og bliver involveret i alt fra LinkedIn-kommunikation, events og tilbudsprocesser til kampagner, markedsanalyser og go-to-market aktiviteter.

Dine kerneopgaver vil bestå af at:

* Planlægge, koordinere og eksekvere kommunikations- og marketingaktiviteter på tværs af relevante kanaler, herunder LinkedIn. Dette omfatter udarbejdelse af opslag baseret på faglige artikler, kundecases og arrangementer samt analyse af rækkevidde, engagement og relevante branchetrends inden for revision, skat, CFO-agendaen og AI.
* Bidrage til udvikling af kommunikations- og marketingmateriale, herunder salgsoplæg, tilbudsmateriale og andet skriftligt og visuelt indhold.
* Understøtte planlægning, markedsføring og afvikling af events og netværksaktiviteter samt rekruttering af deltagere til CFO-netværk og faglige arrangementer.
* Følge op på leads og mødeaktiviteter i forbindelse med afholdte events og netværksaktiviteter.
* Bidrage til den daglige drift af kommunikationsindsatsen og understøtte den lokale kommunikationsstrategi i samarbejde med vores centrale marketingfunktion i København.
* Koordinere samarbejdet med eksterne leverandører, herunder fotografer, og sikre løbende opdatering af billedmateriale til ekstern kommunikation.
* Bidrage til anvendelsen af AI-værktøjer i både intern og ekstern kommunikation, herunder optimering af markedsføringsindhold og udvikling af nye digitale initiativer.
* Arbejde med nyhedsbreve, e-mail marketing samt data og indsigter med henblik på løbende optimering af kommunikations- og marketingindsatser.

Hos KPMG Aarhus bliver du en del af et lokalt revisionshus med globale rødder, hvor mulighederne er mange. Foruden et højt fagligt niveau og et højt engagement blandt kollegaer, vil du opleve, at sociale relationer og kollegialt samspil står os nært.

**Om dig, vores nye kollega**

* Du er under uddannelse inden for kommunikation, journalistik, markedsføring eller lignende. Vi forventer, at du er på kandidatniveau eller i gang med at færdiggøre din bachelor.
* Vi forestiller os, at du har en stor interesse for B2B-markedsføring og professionel rådgivning samt en god forståelse for, hvordan virksomheder arbejder med kommunikation, synlighed og relationer.
* Du er god til digitale platforme og sociale medier og motiveres af at omsætte idéer til konkrete aktiviteter. Samtidig arbejder du struktureret og er god til koordinering og projektstyring, så opgaver bliver fulgt til dørs.
* Du er nysgerrig på AI og nye teknologier samt interesserer dig for kommercielle aktiviteter og forretningsudvikling. Det vigtigste er dog, at du er initiativrig, åben for nye opgaver og har lyst til at bidrage til vores lokale vækst- og markedsføringsarbejde i Aarhus.
* Du er sprogligt dygtig og formår at skrive klart, professionelt og grammatisk korrekt på både dansk og engelsk.
* Derudover er du motiveret, kvalitetsbevidst og omhyggelig. Du stiller store krav til dig selv og dit arbejde. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og komme i mål inden for til tider korte deadlines. Vi vil gerne have, at du er motiveret for personlig og faglig udvikling og har lyst til at sætte dit eget præg på jobbeskrivelsen.

**Vi tilbyder**

Den gennemsnitlige arbejdstid er ca. 15 timer om ugen, hvilket giver dig mulighed for at kombinere dit studie med relevant erhvervserfaring og udvikling af dine kompetencer. Vi er selvfølgelig fleksible i eksamensperioder.

Hos KPMG har vi fokus på det hele menneske. Du vil få rige muligheder for at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt. Vi arbejder i teams og på tværs af niveau, så der vil altid være nogen at spørge og lære af. Du bliver del af en international arbejdsplads med åbne døre og unge, motiverede kollegaer. Vi taler sammen og lytter til hinanden, fordi vi stoler på vores kollegaer, og fordi vi har indset, at gode løsninger ofte opstår på baggrund af mere end ét perspektiv.

**Kontakt og ansøgning**

Vi vil gerne høre fra dig, så du er mere end velkommen til at kontakte Rafi Rahimzai på [rrahimzai@kpmg.com](mailto:rrahimzai@kpmg.com) for at høre mere.

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig, tøv ikke med at søge. For at gøre processen så nem som mulig for dig, kræver vi blot upload af dit CV sammen med dine seneste karakterer (bachelor og kandidat). Vi indkalder kandidater løbende til samtale og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet den rigtige.

Vi opfordrer alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, handicap, race, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Vi ser frem til at få dig ombord.

jobs.title: Trafikvært (barselsvikariat)
jobs.description_md:
Kunne du tænke dig at hjælpe pendlerne sikkert frem på de danske veje? DR København søger en barselsvikar i rollen som trafikvært. Jobbet er for dig, der elsker hurtig formidling både på Danmarks største radiokanal - P4 - trafiksitet på dr.dk og TVA.

**Om jobbet**

P4 Trafik har i alt tre trafikcentre: Et i København, et i Odense og et i Aarhus. Under de regionale morgen- og eftermiddagsflader på P4 sender alle centrene trafikmeldinger fra deres område. Uden for myldretiden i hverdagene og hele weekenden bliver trafikmeldingerne over hele landet sendt fra centret i Trafiktårnet i København. Dine vagter bliver hovedsageligt – men ikke udelukkende – kl. 05-11 eller 12-18 på hverdage.

Som trafikvært hos DR København vil du komme til at arbejde i Trafiktårnet i København, centralt placeret ved Dybbølsbro. Her vil du sidde tæt på medarbejderne i Vejdirektoratets Trafikcenter og i samarbejde med dem og de andre trafikværter sikre, at præcise trafikmeldinger sendes ud i hovedstadsområdet og resten af Danmark.

**Din profil**

* Du kan lide hurtig formidling på radio, tv og web
* Du er god til at holde overblik, selv når der er travlt
* Du er god til at samarbejde med andre – internt som eksternt
* Du er en god kollega
* Du er god til at kommunikere effektivt og professionelt både mundtligt og på skrift
* Du har en troværdig og myndig stemme, der evner at signalere overblik uanset travlhed
* Du har med fordel god geografisk forståelse og et kørekort
* Du har med fordel erfaring med radiomediet

**Vi tilbyder**

En tidsbegrænset stilling på 33 timer som barselsvikar fra december til juli måned.

Vi tilbyder et gennemgribende oplæringsforløb, så du føler dig godt rustet.

Trafikredaktionen hos DR København er en stærk og selvkørende redaktion, hvor der er et godt sammenhold. Vi er i konstant udvikling og ikke én dag er ens. Der kan både være fart over feltet og mere stille timer, hvor der er rum til sparring og faglige diskussioner. Der er 5 fast tilknyttede trafikværter i Trafiktårnet og et større hold studentermedhjælpere. Vi sigter mod at besætte stillingen fra 1. december.

**Kontakt**

DR ønsker at afspejle samfundet. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, religion, handicap og etnisk baggrund til at søge.

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen så kontakt redaktionschef Morten Møbjerg på [mmz@dr.dk](mailto:mmz@dr.dk) eller trafikvært Mads Herholdt (kl. 10:30-18:00) på telefon 3520 6844.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, dit cv og relevante eksamenspapirer. Stillinger i DR søges udelukkende elektronisk. Du søger ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen” i højre side.

Ansøgningsfristen er søndag den 27. september og vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler i uge 43.
